audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar Zelophehad-daughters tribal-inheritance conclusion, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Gileadite clan petition, concern over intertribal marriage and Jubilee, marriage-within-clan ruling, daughters' compliance, retained Manasseh inheritance, and final plains-of-Moab colophon. Strong gender-agency and anti-coercion safeguards required.

verses.restored: Heads of fathers' houses of clan of sons of Gilead son of Machir, son of Manasseh, from clans of sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before leaders, heads of fathers' houses of children of Israel.

familiar.text: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

verses.restored: They said, YHWH commanded my lord to give land as inheritance by lot to children of Israel, and my lord was commanded by YHWH to give inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

familiar.text: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

verses.restored: If they become wives to one from sons of other tribes of children of Israel, then their inheritance will be withdrawn from inheritance of our fathers and added to inheritance of tribe to which they become; so it will be withdrawn from lot of our inheritance.

familiar.text: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

verses.restored: When Jubilee comes for children of Israel, their inheritance will be added to inheritance of tribe to which they become, and from inheritance of tribe of our fathers their inheritance will be withdrawn.

familiar.text: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

verses.restored: Moses commanded children of Israel at mouth/command of YHWH, saying, Tribe of sons of Joseph speaks rightly.

familiar.text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.

verses.restored: This is word YHWH commanded concerning daughters of Zelophehad, saying: To whom is good in their eyes they may become wives, only into clan of tribe of their father they shall become wives.

familiar.text: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.

verses.restored: No inheritance of children of Israel shall turn from tribe to tribe, for children of Israel shall cling each to inheritance of tribe of his fathers.

familiar.text: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

verses.restored: Every daughter possessing inheritance from tribes of children of Israel shall become wife to one from clan of tribe of her father, so children of Israel may possess each inheritance of his fathers.

familiar.text: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

verses.restored: No inheritance shall turn from one tribe to another tribe, for tribes of children of Israel shall cling each to its inheritance.

familiar.text: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

verses.restored: As YHWH commanded Moses, so daughters of Zelophehad did.

familiar.text: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

verses.restored: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, daughters of Zelophehad, became wives to sons of their father's brothers.

familiar.text: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons:

verses.restored: They became wives within clans of sons of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained with tribe of clan of their father.

familiar.text: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

verses.restored: These are commands and judgments that YHWH commanded by hand of Moses to children of Israel in plains of Moab by Jordan at Jericho.

familiar.text: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

translation_notes: The chapter revisits the daughters' victory in Numbers 27 because tribal leaders fear that marriage could transfer land between tribes.
The ruling preserves the daughters' right to choose—'to whom is good in their eyes'—but restricts the eligible group to their father's clan. Agency and patriarchal land control coexist in tension.
The land concern is tied to tribal inheritance and Jubilee, not a claim that women are incapable of holding property.
Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah act within the ruling and retain their inheritance inside Manasseh.
The book ends with women whose petition changed law, even though the final settlement still constrains their marriage choices.
This ancient tribal property rule must not be generalized into modern bans on interfaith, interracial, intercaste, queer, or freely chosen marriage.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 36 to control whom women marry, force endogamy, deny bodily autonomy, preserve family wealth through coercion, or prohibit interracial, interfaith, intercaste, or queer relationships. Honor the daughters' legal courage while naming the final rule's patriarchal constraint.
